Write `compare_rle_streams(stream_a, stream_b, escape_tok)` decoding both escaped RLE streams and returning `[len_a, len_b, first_mismatch_index]` where `first_mismatch_index` is the smallest index where the expanded streams differ (or the shorter length if one is a strict prefix of the other, or `-1` if expanded streams are identical). Escaped RLE stream rules with sentinel `escape_tok`: scan index `i` from 0; if `tokens[i] != escape_tok`, emit literal `tokens[i]` once and advance by 1; if `tokens[i] == escape_tok`: (a) if `i + 1 >= len(tokens)` (dangling trailing escape), emit literal `escape_tok` once and stop; (b) if `tokens[i + 1] == escape_tok` (doubled escape), emit literal `escape_tok` once and advance by 2; (c) else let `val = tokens[i + 1]`: if `i + 2 >= len(tokens)` (truncated run missing count), emit literal `val` once and stop; else let `cnt = tokens[i + 2]`: if `cnt <= 0`, skip all 3 tokens (emit nothing) and advance by 3; else emit `val` repeated `cnt` times and advance by 3.
